tagline: A resume for a more modern age

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.blurb: Open to platform, SRE and infrastructure roles. The fastest way to reach me is email.

leadership.title: How I lead
leadership.summary: I run platform teams the way I run platforms: clear interfaces, measured outcomes, and no heroics. I hire for curiosity, set SLOs for the team as well as the systems, and keep the roadmap public so partner teams can plan around it.

points.title: Teams
points.body: Built and led a 12-person platform group across SRE, developer experience and security.

points.title: Scope
points.body: Owned Kubernetes, delivery and observability for 40+ services and a few million daily users.

points.title: Operating Model
points.body: GitOps for everything, blameless post-mortems, and a published platform roadmap.

highlights.title: Kubernetes, End to End
highlights.body: From bare-metal Talos nodes in the lab to multi-region managed clusters in production. Ingress, storage, policy, upgrades.

highlights.title: GitOps Delivery
highlights.body: Everything is a pull request. Argo CD app-of-apps, reusable GitHub Actions, signed images and policy gates.

highlights.title: Observability First
highlights.body: OpenTelemetry pipelines, SLOs and alerting that pages for symptoms, not causes. Dashboards people actually open.

highlights.title: Secure by Default
highlights.body: Secrets with Vault and SOPS, image scanning with Trivy, least-privilege IAM, and OPA guardrails in CI.

highlights.title: Infrastructure as Code
highlights.body: Terraform modules and Ansible roles that are tested, versioned and reviewed like application code.

highlights.title: This Site Is the Proof
highlights.body: Built with Next.js, shipped as a container, deployed on-prem with the same tooling used at work. Try the terminal above.
